title: The Safe-line Technique as Additional Attempt to Mitigate Spinal Cord Ischemia After Endovascular Exclusion of TAAA
official: The Safe-line Technique as Additional Attempt to Mitigate Spinal Cord Ischemia After Endovascular Thoraco-abdominal Aneurysm Repair
summary: To assess safety and feasebility of the "safe-line" technique in a multicenter international collaboration.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Thoraco-abdominal aortic aneurysm including type I,II,III,IV and V.
* Pararenale aneurysm
* Thoracoabdominal aortic aneurysm Elective and Urgent, endovascular repair;
* Endovascular repair of any thoracoabdominal aortic condition

Exclusion Criteria:

-thoraco-abdominal aortic aneurysm open repair
